q: The first ceremonial President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria when it became a republic in 1963 was Dr. ____. (P6)
explain: Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe ('Zik of Africa') was Governor-General and first President.

q: The Premier of the Western Region who introduced free Universal Primary Education (UPE) in 1955 was Chief ____. (P6)
explain: Chief Obafemi Awolowo pioneered free primary schooling and healthcare in the Western Region.
hint: Premier who introduced free primary education.

q: The Premier of the Northern Region who was a great nationalist and Sardauna of Sokoto was Sir ____. (P6)
explain: Sir Ahmadu Bello developed infrastructure, education, and unity in Northern Nigeria.
hint: Sardauna of Sokoto and Northern Premier.

q: The nationalist pioneer regarded as the 'Father of Nigerian Nationalism' who founded the NNDP in 1923 was ____. (P6)
explain: Herbert Macaulay championed civil liberties and political parties in colonial Lagos.

q: The Organization of African Unity (now the African Union) was founded in Addis Ababa in the year ____. (P6)
explain: The OAU was formed on 25 May 1963 to promote African liberation and unity.
